BIG WINS for America’s workers, seniors, & families under @HOUSEGOP and @POTUS's One Big Beautiful Bill!

The American people are seeking immediate relief from the past four years, and the OBBB is the answer.

-Strengthens Medicaid
-Bolsters our military
-Secures the border
-Delivers historic savings and fiscal responsibility. 

It’s time for the Senate to act and pass the @HouseGOP's OBBB—because America deserves better.

The One Big Beautiful Bill protects Medicaid for Americans who truly need it. This bill eliminates waste, fraud, and abuse by ending benefits for at least 1.4 million illegal immigrants who are gaming the system.

The One Big Beautiful Bill ends taxpayer-funded sex changes. It reverses the Biden-era mandate that Medicaid cover so-called “gender transition” procedures, ending the taxpayer-funded chemical castration and mutilation of American children.

The One Big Beautiful Bill implements critical program integrity and cost containment provisions in Medicaid to strengthen it for future generations. These include removing deceased individuals from the program and limiting retroactive coverage from three months to one month prior to enrollment.

ICYMI: Wrapped up a great conversation on the Ed Dean Morning Show—we talked all things One Big Beautiful Bill!

The @HouseGOP is restoring integrity to Medicaid—cutting out waste and fraud while protecting benefits for those who truly need them: seniors, low-income families, children, pregnant mothers, and individuals with disabilities.

This bill is about making government work smarter and putting Americans first.
The One Big Beautiful Bill protects Medicaid for those who truly need it while cracking down on fraud and abuse. Resources should be prioritized for the most vulnerable in our nation.

NEW: @repkevinhern and I introduced H.R. 4093, the Apples to Apples Comparison Act, to ensure seniors have clear, accurate info when choosing Medicare coverage. 

With $1.3T in Medicare spending and millions relying on Medicare Advantage, flawed data puts access and benefits at risk. It’s time to stop comparing apples to oranges. 🍎🍊
